root_cause.title: A timezone-aware datetime is mixed with a naive datetime.now()
root_cause.pattern: Comparison or arithmetic between a timezone-aware datetime (from the database or API) and a naive value produced by datetime.now(), datetime.utcnow() or datetime.today() without a tz argument.
root_cause.why_it_breaks: Python raises TypeError when naive and aware datetimes are compared or subtracted, so every code path that mixes them crashes as soon as it receives an aware value.
trigger_conditions: the value comes from a timezone-aware source such as the database driver
the other side is created with now(), utcnow() or today() without tz
root_cause.fix_strategy: Create the current time as datetime.now(timezone.utc) and keep every datetime in the service timezone-aware.
